events.name: Bonaire TeK
events.description: Every year, Buddy Dive Resort teams up with Buddy Dive Tek for the most significant technical diving event in the Caribbean. BonaireTeK at Buddy Dive is an exciting week of technical dive demonstrations, presentations, and training!

events.name: Cultural Event – Nos Zjilea
events.description: This event has a fusion of local arts & crafts, plants & vegetables and educational presentations. Enjoy the delicious food while listening to some of the best local musicians as they play live at cultural park Mangazina di Rei located at the east-entrance of Rincon.

events.name: Plaza Invites
events.description:
Every last weekend of the month, we invite a Michelin-starred chef from the Netherlands to cook a spectacular 6-course dinner at Van der Valk Plaza Resort Bonaire. Join us during Plaza Invites for an unforgettable sunset dinner experience. The upcoming September edition features Chef Paul Pollux from Restaurant Aubergine.
Date:
September 26-27th of September
Time:
6:00 pm – 11:00 pm

events.name: Taste of Bonaire: Tourism
events.description: Usually held in the heart of Kralendijk, this event attracts locals and tourists alike to taste a variety of dishes offered on the island, with live music and performances. This is the perfect place to experience the rich culture of Bonaire, including the culmination of all the nationalities that have a hand in creating this wonderful melting pot that so many people call home. It’s in our nature to share this experience with you, so join the fun with friends and family.

events.name: Quarterly Clean Up Dive
events.description:
Four times a year, we organize a Quarterly Clean Up Dive in which we eliminate as much trash from the reef as possible. We do all this with the help of dozens of volunteers. Both divers and non-divers are welcome to join as we also count and categorize the collected debris. We upload the data to the Dive Against Debris database which is part of the PADI AWARE Foundation.

events.name: Kaminda di Arte
events.description: Kaminda di Arte is a weekend-long art route. Throughout the island, artists open their studios, galleries become pop-up creative spaces, and museums welcome visitors—with free admission all weekend. It’s a wonderful opportunity to connect with Bonaire’s creative community, meet artists in person, and discover the island in a totally unique way.

events.name: Kingdom Day
events.description: Kingdom Day is a public holiday on the island of Bonaire, and it is observed on December 15 each year. The holiday commemorates the anniversary when Queen Juliana signed the Charter for the Kingdom of Netherlands in 1954. Majority of the governmental businesses are closed.

events.name: Christmas Day
events.description: Christmas Day is a public holiday celebrated around the world and most Christians celebrate on December 25. On the island, Christmas is celebrated with family and friends. Stores and other businesses are closed on this day.

events.name: Cultural Event – Nos Zjilea
events.description: This event has a fusion of local arts & crafts, plants & vegetables and educational presentations. Enjoy the delicious food while listening to some of the best local musicians as they play live at cultural park Mangazina di Rei located at the east-entrance of Rincon.

events.name: Second Christmas Day
events.description: Second Christmas Day, also known as Boxing Day, is a public holiday celebrated in many countries, and it is observed on December 26, the day after Christma s Day. The majority of businesses are closed, with stores and supermarkets having adapted opening hours.

events.name: New Year’s Eve
events.description: New Year’s Eve is celebrated with different stores and businesses having an end of the year event with pagara (fireworks) during the day. At night the majority of people spend it with their family and friends by enjoying food, music and fireworks. Some hotels have special parties for their guests and locals.

events.name: New Year’s Day – Maskarada
events.description: Maskarada, on New Year’s Day, originates from Bonaire’s Spanish background. Completely disguised, including speech, locals from each village dress and arrive early in groups at the Lt. Governor’s home to dance and play outside wishing the family a Happy New Year (“Bon Aña”). The Lt. Governor thanks them with a bottle of rum, held and dispensed by a designated member.

events.name: King’s Birthday
events.description: An official government ceremony in honor of King Willem Alexander is followed by numerous events and celebrations in Kralendijk.

events.name: Dia di Rincon Cultural Event
events.description: Rincon Day is a special day on the island of Bonaire, where the focus is in the oldest town of Bonaire and the Dutch Caribbean. Visitors can enjoy an array of local cuisines and listen to local music and traditional dances. All of these activities take place in the center of Rincon where locals and visitors meet and enjoy several cultural festivities.

events.name: Labor Day
events.description: Labor Day is a legal holiday. There aren’t any events, but shops, banks and offices are closed.

events.name: Bonaire Flag Day
events.description: A local holiday where the entire island of Bonaire celebrates the existence of the island. Usually it is held within a chosen neighborhood on Bonaire where locals and visitors dance, eat, drink on the streets with several entertainment bands. The Motorcycle event is also one of the major highlights of this day where over 400 participants with their motorcycles are flown in from around the world and they take a tour of the island as part of the national Flag Day ceremony.
